programs.title: One Strange Rock
programs.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programs.title: Wild Cats of India
programs.desc:
A two-part documentary directed by photographer and filmmaker Sandesh Kadur, winner of the 2017 BAFTA award for his work on the program "Planet Earth 2".Wild cats have been considered a symbol of strength and royal power in India since ancient times.There are various species of them in this country.Viewers will learn the secret life of these fascinating animals.The creators of the document will pay special attention to lesser-known representatives of wild cats.Among them will be the Pallas cat, a small predatory mammal with short and massive legs found in Asia.Viewers will also learn about the spotted cat, which is protected by the Washington Convention.This species occurs, among others, in tropical forests and swamps, and to catch prey it jumps into the water.The clouded leopard, which feeds on monkeys and birds, is also a highly endangered species.These cats can, among other things, run headfirst down a tree
In 2023, India will become the most populous country in the world, overtaking China in this respect.In addition to the growing human population, numerous wild cats have lived here for centuries.They are elusive and agile.They can avoid human settlements while enjoying the benefits of such a neighborhood.Filmmaker Sandesh Kadur has embarked on a mission to bring Indian cats closer to home.The two-part documentary portrays animals in their natural environment.A particular challenge was to capture the small steppe manulas, which are masters of camouflage.The gray spirit of the Himalayas The hero of the first part of the documentary is an snow leopard living in the land of eternal snow in the Himalayas.There are currently only about 4,000 individuals of this species living in the world.To survive in extremely hostile conditions, the snow leopard must master the art of hunting.The real treat is animals bred by shepherds from a nearby village.The leopard has the largest range of all large cat species.The crevices in the rocks of southwestern Rajasthan are an ideal hiding place for raising offspring.Viewers will witness a fierce duel between the mother leopard and the intruder.They will also see the last refuge of Asiatic lions and the kingdom of impressive Bengal tigresses.

programs.title: Animal fights
programs.desc: Unique shots of spectacular clashes involving the largest and most dangerous predators on our planet.This extraordinary series also features animals that, although seemingly gentle, are surprisingly belligerent when threatened.We will see how brave they are, among others.lions, wolves, hippos and crocodiles.We will see how much the result of the duel depends on strength and weapons such as teeth or claws, and how much on good tactics.The program used materials recorded by the best nature photographers, as well as films made by amateurs who witnessed fierce fights in the animal world.
